I will plant cassava on this my rented plot using local stem cuttings I saved from last season, because improved varieties are too expensive for me to buy. I will spread some poultry manure I got cheap from a neighbor, but I will not use chemical fertilizer since the cost is too high and this land is not my own. My wife and children will do most of the planting, weeding, and harvesting, though I will hire two young men for five days each to help clear the bush. We do not need irrigation here in the southwest because the rains come well, and I do not spray chemicals on root crops.
